description: Regression corpus for validation::calculate_fee (withdraw fee path). Each case documents intent so a future change that reintroduces a rounding/overflow/edge bug fails CI immediately. See contracts/market/src/validation.rs::calculate_fee and the loader test in contracts/market/src/tests_vectors.rs.

vectors.description: 0 bps fee rate on a normal deposit yields no fee at all.
999 * 25 / 10000 = 2.4975, must floor to 2, never round up.
Small amount at low bps rounds down to a zero fee rather than erroring.
10000 bps (100%) is the maximum allowed rate; the entire amount becomes the fee.
i128::MAX * 2 bps overflows checked_mul and must error, never wrap or panic.
Historical bug shape: a negative withdrawal amount must be rejected up front, not silently produce a negative fee.
fee_rate_bps above 10000 (100%) must be rejected as an invalid price/rate.
